findings.description: The check changed from self.match.match(...) to self.match.fullmatch(...), which silently alters matching semantics beyond the announced empty-message change. Patterns that previously matched a prefix of the exception text no longer match.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="Connection") and an exception with str "Connection refused". Before, re.match anchored at the start returned a match, so the retry happened. After, fullmatch requires the whole string to match, so the check returns False and the retry is skipped. Impact: existing callers that rely on prefix matching stop retrying on transient errors, and the commit title does not announce this change.
